method_note: Owner EXHAUSTIVE PER-LINE METHOD. 10 clips from data/audit_batches.json B16_150-159, dossiers from data/line_trace. All 40 DriverDataTable emitter functions in functions/*.c were listed by regex (18 dynamic, 22 literal). Emit sites of the dynamic functions were read in full; the literal ones were checked by their literal eid argument. Owner exe (F1 Challenge Online.exe in the 99-02 folder) read byte-wise, read only, for event rows 141-155. No live game.
owner_exe_check: event table 0x5BF9A0 + eid*0x14: +0 priority, +0x0C cooldown, +0x10 score. Eids 141-153: priority 70, cooldown 1.0, score = eid+3. Eid 154 cooldown 20.0, eid 155 cooldown 1.0. Eid 80 = FLT_MAX, 106 = 15.0, 117 = 6.0 (matches the coordinator check).
contradictions: doc56 labels SDT 164 (eid 155) 'Speeding in pits penalty'; code sub_41A720 writes eid 155 for JUMPED START, and owner TRIAGE_NOTES.txt:164 says 'stop go for jumpstart'. The doc56 label is wrong.
doc56 labels SDT 150 (eid 141) 'Stop/go penalty'; owner triage 150 says 'overtaking under yellow'.
doc56 labels SDT 151 (eid 142) 'Cutting track penalty'; owner triage 151 says 'speeding in the pitlane, 25 second version'.

SDT 153, 155, 157, 159 are used by SoundEventDispatcher case 0x32 -> MapCollisionShapeToBoneIndex (sub_412C30:57,60,63,66) as number-word sub-clips (30, 35, 40, 50). The doc56 names say penalty/investigation lines. Either the names or the resolver mapping is wrong; a listening test is needed. Which lines use type 0x32 is UNKNOWN.

eid 148 collides with the Nurburgring track-name id (TrackNameDisplayIDLookup sub_417F60:179 returns 148 when a4=0). SDT 148 = PWS_PENALTY08 (doc56 row 139). Consumer of the track-name id is UNKNOWN (scene-list builder, file paths).
eids 141-152 are also driver-name ids in DriverNameIDLookup (sub_415D90). Those are name-table outputs, not event rows; event-queue use is UNKNOWN.

findings.jsonl:89 said the dump was stale for blocked flags; for eid 149 the owner exe matches dump blocked=false (cooldown 1.0).
